snippet.title: LEAVES 3 | Launch Trailer | Out Now!
snippet.description:
The dreamlike journey continues. LEAVES 3, the new chapter in the artistically acclaimed puzzle-adventure series by developer ZAR21 and publisher Daedalic Entertainment, is out now on Steam.

Explore a surreal handcrafted world made from real sculptures, solve puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and rescue the scattered Treefruities on their journey to a warm and peaceful haven.

Get it on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4460170/LEAVES_3/
